genericProblem: A business-facing delivery can retain a mechanically green changed-file receipt set while its current evidence summary is stale, its dynamic-verification state is not truthfully represented, or a contract narrowing leaves a same-feature consumer and scope path inconsistent.

RM1-U04 P3-C package exit, amendment, generated replay evidence and hook-receipt chain

counterexamples.evidence: Three current generated outputs have later 015/016 pre/post receipt edges returning them to the exact baseline and then to their current final bytes; the unchanged create wire remains covered by its original chain; validate-delta-receipts for RM1-U04 passes.
RM1-U01 P0 modifies backend production files yet is a control-only package whose business result can honestly be NOT_APPLICABLE; file paths cannot mechanically infer business-verification duty.
The approved operations ContextSelector consumes only owner-supplied data-node candidates and the session owner validates a selected candidate; this is not arbitrary client scope injection.

findings.verifiedPortion: The historical replay evidence no longer describes the current generator/output tuple; the claim that the generated write-channel bypass recurred is rejected because later receipt edges exist.

P3 U02/U03/U04 exits lack a business-verification obligation and dynamic-evidence representation although the approved P3 units require focused business/negative validation. The claimed historical fixture run and exact cause are UNVERIFIED_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE because no run-scoped log/result survives in the repository.
The U04 exit records changed-byte compliance but has no explicit, source-anchored authorization-semantics assertion set for descendant visibility, scope-out and server-derived target checks.

The approved owner-confirmed context selector may choose a descendant data node, but resolveTaskScope interprets the selected node id using the assignment type. GROUP/REGION selections of descendant candidates therefore fail before the ancestor authorization predicate. This is an implementation defect, not a product ambiguity.

The operations membership/invitation feature still sends scopeRef to detail, revoke, cancel and reissue after those operations were narrowed to no scopeRef in the generated contract. This is the same contract-scope drift family and must be removed with the resolver repair.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: P3 remediation package exit must distinguish immutable historical replay from current-chain closure and bind each current generator/output pair to its receipts.
tools/compliance-control/cli.mjs package-exit schema/validator, with an explicit package-declared businessEvidenceObligation rather than a path heuristic.
P3 remediation package exit authorizationSemanticsEvidence assertions bound to concrete test methods and negative behavior.
Existing workspace-IAM focused test surface must exercise owner-confirmed descendant selection, peer rejection and leaf identity behavior.
Contract-change review checklist must trace removed operation parameters through generated clients and every same-feature consumer invocation.
